additional_info.subject: RE: ID0459053-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2/SD314015297001] DC2 not operative CRM:02681001011
additional_info.body:
Dear Giuseppe,
I have checked the charger remotely and the charger has 2 active alarms:
Error code 20 - Outlet not ready - standby insulation monitor state is not valid
IMD-BC2 - maximum system leakage capacitance exceeded: 0.0microF
I have hard rebooted the charger and the error have been deactivated. I believe the problem is solved.
Please let me know if I can close this ticket.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Laura Martins,
Please do not change the subject of this email when replying to it.
